Though it did not produce silverware, '''[[FC Barcelona]]''''s '''2007–08 season''' would mark a period of change within the club, having many firsts and lasts. Most importantly, this would be [[Ronaldinho]]'s last season with the club, being displaced by the coming of [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]] legend [[Thierry Henry]]. This season also marked the breakthrough of young talent [[Bojan Krkić]] into the first team, as well as the emergence of [[Lionel Messi]] as one of the team's key players. On the other hand, this would be [[Lilian Thuram]]'s last season as a professional footballer, as well as [[Gianluca Zambrotta]]'s last with the club.

==Events==
[[File:Thierry Henry FC Barcelona cropped.jpg|right|thumb|100px|[[Thierry Henry]], a €24 million move from [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]].]]

* 25 June: [[Thierry Henry]] moves from [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]] to Barcelona for €24 million.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120802053421/http://www.fcbarcelona.cat/web/english/noticies/futbol/temporada06-07/06/n070625101079.html|title=FCBarcelona.cat: Bienvenu Monsieur Henry}}</ref>
* 29 August: Nike will supply Barcelona until the 2017–18 season.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120730110511/http://www.fcbarcelona.cat/web/english/noticies/club/temporada07-08/08/n070829100839.html|title=FCBarcelona.cat: The Assembly approves Nike deal until 2018}}</ref>
* 22 September: The [[Camp Nou]] turns 50 years old with a celebration full of music, light, and colour.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120802033752/http://www.fcbarcelona.cat/web/english/noticies/club/temporada07-08/09/n070922101096.html|title=FCBarcelona.cat: Happy birthday Camp Nou!}}</ref>
* 22 September: A large reform for the [[Camp Nou]] was revealed, with plans to make the Camp Nou bigger, with a retractable roof and better facilities.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120904231111/http://www.fcbarcelona.cat/web/english/noticies/club/temporada07-08/09/n070922101093.html|title=FCBarcelona.cat: The new Camp Nou}}</ref><ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120801130055/http://www.fcbarcelona.cat/web/english/noticies/club/temporada07-08/09/n070922101094.html|title=FCBarcelona.cat: Norman Foster: "It's a personal challenge"}}</ref><ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120731133234/http://www.fcbarcelona.cat/web/english/noticies/club/temporada07-08/09/n070924101120.html|title=FCBarcelona.cat: Foster: "We want to create the best stadium in the world"}}</ref>
* 20 October: [[Bojan Krkić|Bojan]] becomes the youngest ever player to score for the club in [[La Liga]].<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20070623001211/http://www.fcbarcelona.com/web/english/futbol/temporada_07-08/arxiu_partits/lliga/jornada08/Villarreal_Barcelona/partit.html|title=FCBarcelona.cat: Villarreal continue the hoodoo (3-1)}}</ref>
* 26 October: Barça opens a community centre for children in [[Senegal]].<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120729170328/http://www.fcbarcelona.cat/web/english/noticies/club/temporada07-08/10/n071026101915.html|title=FCBarcelona.cat: Richard Toll support centre opens}}</ref>
* 20 March: Barcelona are knocked out of the Copa del Rey at the semi-final stage by [[Valencia CF|Valencia]].<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120729181621/http://www.fcbarcelona.cat/web/english/noticies/futbol/temporada07-08/03/n080321101880.html|title=FCBarcelona.cat: One defeat ends run}}</ref>
* 8 May: The club announces that head coach [[Frank Rijkaard]] will leave the club when his contracts expires at the end of June, and that [[Pep Guardiola]] will replace him.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120525172745/http://www.fcbarcelona.cat/web/english/noticies/futbol/temporada07-08/05/n080508104104.html|title=FCBarcelona.cat: Rijkaard until 30 June; Guardiola to take over.}}</ref>

==Players==
===Squad information===
[[File:Carles Puyol 18abr2007.jpg|right|thumb|100px|[[Carles Puyol]], the [[Captain (association football)|captain]] of FC Barcelona in the 2007–08 season.]]

The squad has reasonably changed in the summer transfer window. The biggest addition was [[Thierry Henry]], with a [[transfer fee]] of [[Euro|€]]24 million. That equals the [[transfer fee]] paid for [[Samuel Eto'o]] in 2004, but just below the €30 million paid for [[Ronaldinho]] in 2003. Other additions were [[Eric Abidal]], [[Yaya Touré]], and [[Gabriel Milito]] . On the other end, some important players that were often used last season have left the club, such as, [[Giovanni van Bronckhorst]] and [[Ludovic Giuly]]. Barcelona still used a great number of players developed in its [[youth system]], 9 of 23, and have two new additions this season: [[Giovani dos Santos]] and [[Bojan Krkić|Bojan]] (17 years old, the youngest player on the squad).

Most of the players have contracts beyond this end of season, but [[Deco]], an important player, has his contract ending in 2008. The captain is still [[Carles Puyol]], who is from [[FC Barcelona B|Barcelona's youth system]], plays in the first squad since 1999 and currently is the player with the most appearances (268). Currently, the highest scorer is Ronaldinho, with 80 goals. Also Ronaldinho, from August of this year, has a [[European passport]]. On mid-October, [[Samuel Eto'o]] received Spanish nationality, making him an [[European Union|EU]] player.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120801082416/http://www.fcbarcelona.cat/web/english/noticies/futbol/temporada07-08/10/n071017101231.html|title=FCBarcelona.cat: Eto'o receives Spanish nationality}}</ref> The only non-EU player is Yaya Touré. Because Spain ratified the [[Cotonou Agreement]] in 2007, however, Touré is now considered an EU player, as his native country of [[Ivory Coast]] is a [[ACP countries|signatory to that agreement]], and the 2003 [[Kolpak ruling]] extended the [[Bosman ruling]] to nations with an associate trading relationship with the EU.<br />

===Squad stats===
[[File:Víctor Valdés - 001.jpg|right|thumb|150px|[[Víctor Valdés]] has the most starts in this season.]]

[[Víctor Valdés]] and [[Eric Abidal]] have been the only two players that have started all the matches (excepting [[Copa Catalunya]], when Barcelona didn't use the same players as for the other competitions). Previously, [[Gianluca Zambrotta]] and [[Yaya Touré]] started all the matches until they got injured. [[Oleguer Presas|Oleguer]] replaced Zambrotta and [[Andrés Iniesta]] replaced Touré. [[Giovani dos Santos]] and [[Bojan Krkić|Bojan]] were the substitute forwards, while [[Santiago Ezquerro]] played only in the [[Copa Catalunya]], as well as [[Eiður Guðjohnsen]] playing once. [[Thierry Henry]] started the majority of the matches when [[Samuel Eto'o]] got injured. He scored his first [[Hat-trick#Association football|hat trick]] wearing Barça's jersey, and he's the second goal scorer with four goals. [[Ronaldinho]] missed three matches due to an injury.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120730165253/http://www.fcbarcelona.cat/web/english/noticies/futbol/temporada07-08/09/n070922101084.html|title=FCBarcelona.cat: Ronaldinho to miss Sevilla match}}</ref> <br />

==Club==

===Coaching staff===
[[File:Frank Rijkaard (2007).jpg|right|thumb|100px|[[Frank Rijkaard]], managing Barcelona since 2003.]]

This season will be the fifth consecutive season for [[Frank Rijkaard]] as Barcelona's manager. Even though Barça did not win any major competition last season,<ref>[[2006–07 FC Barcelona season#Competitions|2006–07 FC Barcelona season]]</ref> club president [[Joan Laporta]] confirmed Rijkaard's presence for this season.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120804104216/http://www.fcbarcelona.cat/web/english/noticies/futbol/temporada06-07/06/n070619100998.html|title=FCBarcelona.cat: Changes on the way}}</ref> All staff from last season, except doctor Gil Rodas, are remaining.<ref>[[2006–07 FC Barcelona season#Coaching staff|2006–07 FC Barcelona season]]</ref><br />
